_readme: Separate product from Featured clinic listings: a sponsor is a business that is NOT a
clinic in the directory (a law firm, a device maker, a pharmacy), so it can never touch
rank order or slice membership. Build-time static, zero tracking scripts. Clicks route
through /go/<id>, a Pages Function that counts server-side and redirects — no pixel.
Fields: id (slug, also the /go/ key) · name · url (landing page) · active (master switch)
· starts/ends (ISO dates, inclusive; either optional) · states (2-letter codes; the card
renders only on pages IN one of these states — [] = national) · placements (any of
state, zone, clinic, article) · articles (article slugs the card may follow; ['*'] = every
article; [] = none) · kicker/headline/body/cta (the creative) · phone (optional; rendered
as a tel: link) · disclosure (optional extra line, e.g. 'Attorney advertising').

samakow-law: month 1 is a free trial in ONE state (VA, the Vienna office; MD is a one-word switch). The paid quarter widens states to VA, MD and DC and attaches the article. He is licensed in VA and MD, not DC, so the creative names only those two even when DC pages carry the card.
